words.gloss: if one is able to manage

literal: If [one] can manage [one's] desired things without [one's] desire being known, the schemes of enemies [will become] useless.
translation: If a leader can indulge in their desires without letting others know of their attachment, the hostile schemes of their enemies will prove utterly useless.
modern: ஒருவர் தமக்கு விருப்பமானவற்றை, தன் விருப்பம் பிறருக்குத் தெரியாதவாறு அனுபவிக்கவோ அல்லது நடத்தவோ முடியுமானால், அவருடைய பகைவர்களின் சதித் திட்டங்கள் யாவும் பயனற்றவை ஆகிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how a leader can protect themselves from the schemes of adversaries by concealing their personal desires. If enemies discover what a leader loves or craves, they will exploit that vulnerability to plot against them. However, if the leader can manage their desires in such a secret way that no one else knows about their attachment, then the enemies' strategic plots (நூல்) will fail and become completely ineffective (ஏதில). Thus, keeping one's personal desires hidden is a vital shield against external threats.
